gppdbuo.notes: • Consider one-to-many scenario, e.g. store site once and allocate to multiple customers. Benefit is reduced data for duplicate sites under different customers. UI/UX would need to be extremely clear when updating things like email addresses, to make sure they know it may impact more than 1 customer.

zw3jvwo.notes:
• Store items under stages to allow multi-collect, multi-deliver stages. E.g. collect 10 items at first collection, then 2 more stages each delivering 5 items. Storing items at "Job" level doesn't allow this
  • Consider nesting "Items", e.g. top level item is "Pallets" then lower level items are the individual product lines. Calidus did this well from memory (Ask Matt T). 
  • Consider nested items being optionally hidden to driver, e.g. driver may be delivering "Pallets" without knowledge of what is in them, but the customer requires a POD for the products rather than the "Pallets"
